shots.title: Define closeout policy inputs for scorecard, sprint review, branch push state, PR existence, and PR review state (#468)
shots.notes: Defined the closeout policy around scorecard presence, retrospective markdown presence, upstream push state, current-branch PR metadata, PR implementation review state, and branch-size thresholds.

shots.title: Add PR status/closeout preflight reporting for current branch review readiness (#468)

hazards.description: During closeout, the globally installed slope binary did not include the new pr status subcommand, so source-built validation had to use node dist/cli/index.js until the patch release ships.

shots.notes: Added slope pr status with closeout formatting, push and branch-size probes, PR metadata lookup, and reviewed/pending/missing PR review state resolution.

shots.title: Warn from sprint retrospective review when PR review state is missing (#468)
shots.notes: Sprint retrospective generation now warns that retrospective review is not the same as PR implementation review unless a matching PR review record is already complete.

shots.title: Add branch-size guardrails and regressions for closeout/PR review discipline (#468)

hazards.description: Round 1 review found the shared shell segment parser split only semicolon, newline, &&, and ||; single pipelines and background operators could bypass guard intent until fixed.

shots.notes: Added branch file/commit warning helpers and regressions. Review follow-up commit 2aa2283 tightened guard shell-segment parsing and added pipeline regressions for phase-boundary and worktree-check.

conditions.description: The sprint landed after PR creation, so closeout validation needed to distinguish local source-built behavior from the released global CLI.

training.description: Closeout commands must validate the full PR readiness path, not just generate retrospective notes.
training.outcome: slope pr status now reports scorecard, sprint review, push state, PR existence, PR review state, and branch size in one preflight.

training.description: Guard command allowlists need shell parser tests for all command separators.
training.outcome: The review follow-up added pipeline coverage and parser handling for single | and background & separators.

nutrition.description: pnpm run typecheck, pnpm test, pnpm run build, and slope roadmap validate passed after the review-found fix.
Standard SLOPE review completed 2/2 rounds, and PR #469 GitHub checks passed.
The source-built closeout status now verifies the PR review record, but the global binary will not expose the command until the patch release.

nineteenth_hole.how_did_it_feel: Useful but a little meta: the sprint added closeout guardrails, then immediately used them to catch missing closeout artifacts.
nineteenth_hole.advice_for_next_player: After opening a PR, run the source-built closeout status before calling the branch ready, and treat missing scorecard or retrospective markdown as real blockers.
nineteenth_hole.what_surprised_you: The auto-card dry run undercounted S130 because several commits were broad S130 or S130-review scopes rather than exact roadmap ticket keys.
nineteenth_hole.excited_about_next: Ship this with the S128/S129 guard recovery fixes so future PRs have a clearer closeout path.

bunker_locations: Auto-card commit heuristics can undercount multi-ticket closeout work when commits use broad S130 or S130-review scopes.
Local development validation can accidentally run the released global slope binary instead of the branch source; use node dist/cli/index.js for unreleased commands after building.
Guard shell command parsing must split all command separators used by shells, including single | and background &.
yardage_book_updates: Use slope pr status --sprint=<N> after PR creation to check scorecard, retrospective review markdown, push state, PR existence, implementation review state, and branch size.
Use slope pr review --pr=<N> --sprint=<N> for implementation review; slope review <scorecard> is only the sprint retrospective.
For unreleased CLI changes in the SLOPE repo, run pnpm run build and then node dist/cli/index.js <command> to validate source-built behavior.
